abstract.p: This systematic review summarizes randomized trials of ACE variants.

sec.title: Methods
sec.p: The sample included N=196 healthy athletes: males (N=143) and females (N=53). Mean age was 42.5 ± 11.4 years.
Genotypes deviated from Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium. BMI and smoking were included as covariates.

sec.title: Results
sec.p: The ACE effect was beta=-47.7, p=0.01. Bonferroni correction was applied.

ref.mixed-citation: A different cohort had N=999 and p=0.9.
